description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various relational and visual concepts evaluated in a benchmark for assessing multi-granularity and multi-image relational association capabilities in large visual language models. There are a total of 10 categories shown in the chart. The categories and their respective counts and percentages are as follows: NearSameEntity (63, 6.34%), RelativePosition (81, 7.90%), MentalitySimilarity (89, 8.67%), SimilarEvent (90, 8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (90, 8.77%), Layout (90, 8.77%), Environment (90, 8.77%), UsageSimilarity (100, 9.65%), SubEvent (100, 9.74%), and ObservationAngle (126, 12.28%). The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and does not have a legend. The segments are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
